"""Assemble compact durable evidence from the executed isolated packer phases."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import tomllib

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/6f70b20c54b6')
REPO = ROOT / 'FerroUI'
RECOVERY = ROOT / 'ferro-build-recovery'
PACKAGE = ROOT / 'ferro-portable-packer/package-02'
BUILD = ROOT / 'ferro-portable-packer/build-01'
CHECK = ROOT / 'ferro-portable-packer/validation-02'
OUT = REPO / 'docs/benchmarks/compiled-theme-portable-packer-linux-x86_64.json'
assert not OUT.exists()

def ident(p):
    p = Path(p)
    with p.open('rb') as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
    return {'path': str(p.resolve()), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': digest}

def read(p):
    return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())

material = read(PACKAGE / 'materialization.json')
build = read(BUILD / 'build.json')
before = read(BUILD / 'resolved-lock-before.json')
after = read(BUILD / 'resolved-lock-after.json')
check = read(CHECK / 'result.json')
archives = read(CHECK / 'archives/archives.json')
source = read(RECOVERY / 'release-candidate-01/source.json')
toolchain = read(RECOVERY / 'toolchain/installation.json')
assert check['complete'] and check['returncode'] == 0
assert before['resolved_lock'] == after['resolved_lock']
assert before['external_packages'] == after['external_packages']
assert before['immutable_inputs_verified'] and after['immutable_inputs_verified']
assert ident(build['executable']['path']) == build['executable'] == check['packer']
for relative, expected in material['files'].items():
    assert ident(expected['path']) == expected, relative
for relative, item in material['verbatim_copies'].items():
    original = material['source_inputs'][item['source']]
    assert item['copied']['sha256'] == original['sha256']
    assert ident(item['copied']['path']) == item['copied']
    assert ident(original['path']) == original
compiler_records = []
for path in sorted((BUILD / 'compilers').glob('*.json')):
    record = read(path)
    assert record['returncode'] == 0
    compiler_records.append({'record': ident(path), **record})
assert 'ferroui_base' not in {item['crate'] for item in compiler_records}
local_packages = [{'name': p['name'], 'version': p['version']} for p in
                  tomllib.loads((PACKAGE / 'Cargo.lock').read_text())['package'] if not p.get('source')]
assert {item['name'] for item in local_packages} == {'ferroui-portable-archive-tool', 'xamlx'}
copied_inputs = {name: {'source': item['source'], 'bytes': item['copied']['bytes'],
                       'sha256': item['copied']['sha256']}
                 for name, item in material['verbatim_copies'].items()}
theme_inputs = {str(Path(item['path']).relative_to(Path(source['directory']) / 'src/FerroUI.Themes.WinUI')):
                {'bytes': item['bytes'], 'sha256': item['sha256']}
                for item in build['theme_inputs']}
assert len(theme_inputs) == 169
commands = []
for row in build['commands']:
    if row['label'] == 'pack-matrix':
        continue
    commands.append({**{k: v for k, v in row.items() if k not in ['resources', 'stdout', 'stderr']},
                     'stdout': Path(row['stdout']).read_text(), 'stderr': Path(row['stderr']).read_text()})
cases = {}
for row in check['canonical_checks']:
    assert row['matches']
    actual = ident(row['actual']['path'])
    assert actual == row['actual']
    detail = archives['cases'][row['case']]
    cases[row['case']] = {**row, **{k: detail[k] for k in ['font', 'command', 'stdout', 'stderr'] if k in detail}}
failure, = [row for row in build['commands'] if row['label'] == 'pack-matrix']
assert failure['returncode'] == 1
generic = Path(source['directory']) / 'src/FerroUI.Themes.WinUI/Resources/Generic.xaml'
anchor = '<x:Double x:Key="ControlContentThemeFontSize">14</x:Double>'
assert generic.read_text().count(anchor) == 3
compact = Path(source['directory']) / 'src/FerroUI.Themes.WinUI/DensityStyles/Compact.xaml'
assert compact.read_text().count(anchor) == 1
report = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'scope': 'Executed isolated archive-tool build and byte-for-byte archive reproduction; not an application build or performance comparison.',
    'conclusion': {'tool_build_passed': True, 'canonical_archives_passed': 8,
                   'shipping_graph_substitution_allowed': False,
                   'shipping_size_or_throughput_claim': False,
                   'training_executable_launched': False,
                   'no_runtime_source_or_archive_codec_changes': True},
    'source': {'head': source['head'], 'tree': source['tree'],
               'source_manifest': ident(RECOVERY / 'release-candidate-01/source.json'),
               'frozen_directory_at_execution': source['directory'],
               'compile_directory_provenance': source['compile_directory']},
    'materialization': {'record': ident(PACKAGE / 'materialization.json'),
                        'producer': material['producer'], 'package': material['package'],
                        'xamlx_version': material['xamlx_version'],
                        'verbatim_copied_inputs': copied_inputs,
                        'source_links_materialized_as_regular_files': material['source_links_materialized_as_regular_files'],
                        'facade_extraction': material['facade_extraction'],
                        'generated_sources': {name: {'identity': ident(PACKAGE / name), 'text': (PACKAGE / name).read_text()}
                                              for name in ['Cargo.toml', 'lib.rs', 'compiler_extensions.rs']},
                        'immutable_input_count': len(material['files']),
                        'all_immutable_inputs_verified_before_and_after_compiler': True},
    'dependency_lock': {'original_seed': material['lock_seed'],
                        'resolved': after['resolved_lock'],
                        'resolved_text': (PACKAGE / 'Cargo.lock').read_text(),
                        'local_packages': local_packages,
                        'external_packages': after['external_packages'],
                        'every_external_tuple_present_in_original_source_lock': True,
                        'pre_and_post_verification_records': [ident(BUILD / 'resolved-lock-before.json'),
                                                              ident(BUILD / 'resolved-lock-after.json')]},
    'build': {'record': ident(BUILD / 'build.json'), 'producer': build['producer'],
              'rustc_wrapper': build['rustc_wrapper'],
              'policy': 'Tooling-only opt0, CGU128, debug assertions, ordinary native unwind, LTO off, no PGO; one Cargo job and Rayon thread.',
              'controlled_environment': build['environment'], 'cpu_affinity': build['cpu_affinity'],
              'compiler_version': toolchain['compiler'], 'cargo_version': toolchain['cargo'],
              'toolchain_installation': build['toolchain'], 'rustc': build['rustc'], 'cargo': build['cargo'],
              'commands': commands, 'compiler_records': compiler_records, 'executable': build['executable'],
              'native_link_arguments_captured': False,
              'timing_scope': 'Elapsed build duration and child peak RSS are diagnostic resource observations, not paired compile-time benchmarks.'},
    'canonical_archive_validation': {'record': ident(CHECK / 'result.json'),
                                     'producer': check['producer'], 'validator': check['validator'],
                                     'command': check['command'], 'returncode': check['returncode'],
                                     'stdout': Path(check['stdout']['path']).read_text(),
                                     'stderr': Path(check['stderr']['path']).read_text(),
                                     'tmpdir_override': check['tmpdir_override'],
                                     'packer_and_validator_unchanged': check['unchanged_validator_and_packer'],
                                     'canonical_evidence': build['canonical_evidence'],
                                     'theme_document_count': len(theme_inputs), 'theme_inputs': theme_inputs, 'cases': cases},
    'retained_prior_validation_failure': {'record': ident(BUILD / 'build.json'),
                                         'phase': failure['label'], 'command': failure['argv'],
                                         'returncode': failure['returncode'],
                                         'stdout': Path(failure['stdout']).read_text(),
                                         'stderr': Path(failure['stderr']).read_text(),
                                         'diagnosis': 'The original validator required one Generic.xaml font anchor; the actual source has three Default/Light/HighContrast anchors, which original profile_winui.make_archives replaces together.',
                                         'generic_anchor_count': 3, 'compact_anchor_count': 1,
                                         'tool_binary_rebuilt_for_correction': False,
                                         'first_four_canonical_matches': read(BUILD / 'partial-validation.json')['checks']},
    'resource_boundary': {'closed_development_cache_advice': ident(RECOVERY / 'development-cache-release-01.json'),
                          'application_headroom_gate': read(RECOVERY / 'application-headroom-gate-01.json'),
                          'no_new_full_application_compiler_started': True},
    'assembly': {'producer': ident(__file__), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(ident(OUT), indent=2))
